lines.introduction:
You are Lea, a courier wearing a borrowed official uniform. At dusk, you arrive outside the royal gate to recover a missing ledger. Sen, the archivist who once saved your life, may be able to help.

Your mission is to recover the ledger before nightfall (tick 20) and bring it safely back outside. Oren guards the entrance, and you are not expected: your first challenge is to get past him. Describe what you say or do in plain English. Actions advance time; /look and /inventory do not.
lines.gate_success: Oren: The seal looks proper. Go through.
lines.gate_failure: Oren: I need new evidence before I can admit you.
lines.collateral: Oren: Leave the seal with me as collateral, and I will admit you.
lines.sen_greeting: Sen: Lea! I am glad you came.
lines.ledger_secret: Sen: The ledger shows that the deputy redirected relief supplies. Please preserve it.
lines.key_offer: Sen: Take my key, if you promise to return it.
lines.verification: Oren: The invitation could not be verified. Explain yourself.
lines.compel: Sen asks you to deliver an archive receipt to Oren before leaving.
lines.victory: You carry the recovered ledger outside the gate. The mission is complete.
